question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The girl ran into the house to get some ______ of bread, cold potatoes and other such morsels as were suitable for the fowls.
solution:
The correct answer is: **crumbs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The words given in options are called** collective nouns.**
 
• A collective noun is a noun that refers to some sort of group or collective—of people, animals, things, etc.
 
• Collective nouns are normally not treated as plural, even though they refer to a group of something.
 
• Let's look at the options given.
 
 
• **Heaps **mean an untidy pile of something. (वस्‍तुओं का अव्‍यवस्थित ढेर)
 
 
• **Example -** *Heaps of garbage*
 
 
 
• **Shells **mean a hard covering that protects eggs, nuts and some animals. (एक कठोर आवरण जो अंडे, नट और कुछ जानवरों की रक्षा करता है)
 
 
• **Example - ***A midden of shells*
 
 
 
• Crumbs mean a very small dry piece of bread, cake or biscuit. (ब्रेड, केक या बिस्किट का एक बहुत छोटा सूखा टुकड़ा)
 
 
• Example - *Crumbs of bread*
 
 
 
• **Bars **mean a straight piece of wood or metal that is longer than it is wide. (लकड़ी या धातु का एक सीधा टुकड़ा जो चौड़ा होने की तुलना में लंबा होता है) 
 
 
• **Example -** *Bars of gold.*
 
 
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete sentence:** *The girl ran into the house to get some crumbs of bread__, cold potatoes, and other such morsels as were suitable for the fowls. *
